dct_title_s: Soudan Mine, No. 8 Shaft, 27th Level, East, Soudan, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A map of the 27th level at the Soudan Mine starting from the No. 8 Shaft going eaSaint The map shows the drift, cross cuts, rock formations, raises, core sample drill holes, and stope areas. Lake Superior Datum.
